title: The Owner runs more than one copy of a flow, each with its own name, config, state, drafts and spend
description: The loop protocol doc (2026-11-11, Build next item 5) and the one-prompt canvas need a second "find yoga teachers" flow beside the first, but fwd runs one copy per engine: ENGINES and every flow module key their state by one fixed flow key. A copy is a new flow key "<base>--<slug>" recorded in the Supervisor settings with copy_of = base. One pure resolver maps a key to its base flow and its home: a shipped flow keeps $FW_HOME, a copy gets $FW_HOME/copies/<key>/, and every engine, cycle, draft and spend path runs the base flow's code against that home, so copies never share leads, drafts, hunts or spend while the engines stay unchanged. POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{base}/copy { slug?, name?, note?, config? } makes one (CLI token or paired session): slug defaults to the next free number from 2; config is a shallow patch over the base flow's effective config, limited to keys it already has, written as the copy's config.json override. A copy of a copy, and copies of host-moments, local-pulse and email-queue (fixed templates or one shared queue), are refused. GET /v1/supervisor lists copies beside shipped flows with copy_of (null on shipped ones). Enable, disable, dial, edit, archive, restore, schedule, intensity, AI account, run and the drafts routes all take a copy's key; turning a copy on registers its own stream (its key, a stream id derived from it), its run report names the copy's key, and fwd reaps a crashed copy's cycle like any other. Deleting a copy is archive for now; the site, relay and Flows page buttons are a later row.
acceptance: POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{base}/copy makes <base>--<slug> off and at draft, with the Owner's name, note and config patch; the base flow's config is untouched
No session 401; unknown base 404; a bad slug, an over-long key, an unknown config key or a copy of a copy 400; an existing copy 409; no slug gives <base>--2
GET /v1/supervisor lists the copy with copy_of; shipped flows show copy_of null
Turning the copy on registers its own stream; running it drafts into $FW_HOME/copies/<key>/flows/<base>/drafts, its run report names the copy, and its spend shows on the copy only
Dial, edit and archive on a copy change only that copy, and copies survive a restart of fwd
